title: El Pan de Comala, MEXI TV
comment: pan-comala (MEXITV): panadería tradicional en Comala, Colima. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.MATILDE_RUELAS: Mexican woman from Colima, baker, 30 years old, light-brown skin, curly black hair tied under a white bandana, a red t-shirt under a white baker's apron dusted with flour, jeans, her hands empty.
chars.CLEMENCIA_RUELAS: Mexican grandmother from Colima, baker, 78 years old, small, brown wrinkled skin, short curly white hair, a navy-blue dress with small white flowers, a white apron, flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.TONO_BECERRA: Mexican man, 35 years old, stocky, light-brown skin, a short black beard, a plain black cap with no logo, a grey sleeveless hoodie, a gold chain, dark cargo trousers, white sneakers, his hands empty.
chars.HORACIO_VALDEZ: Mexican boss, 55 years old, tall, light-brown skin, slicked-back grey hair, grey stubble, a black suit with an open black shirt, a gold watch, black shoes, holding a black hat.

locs.LOC_PANADERIA: Traditional bakery in Comala, Colima, in the morning: a big wood-fired brick oven with glowing embers, wicker baskets full of Mexican sweet bread, a long wooden counter, white walls with red clay tile roof beams, an open door to a cobblestone street with white houses and a volcano far away, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
